findings.title: Flood damage disrupts learning for at least 5,500 children
findings.affected_population_or_system: Children; temporary learning and protection spaces
findings.summary: Flooding affected 109 learning spaces, keeping at least 5,500 children from classes; 15 child/protection spaces sustained damage.
